observations: Silver sportbike-style motorcycle parked on a paved surface.
Front fairing has a large windscreen and dual headlights.
Rear fairing has a black seat and a small black bag attached to the rear.
Front disc brake with gold-colored caliper visible.
No visible damage or major wear in the photos.
Watermark 'DONSON AUTOS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on all photos.
No visible brand or model name on the front or side panels in any photo.

claims.evidence: No visible Triumph logo or Sprint model name in any photo. The brand and model are not readable.
No engine or VIN plate visible to confirm displacement. The seller's text is unverified by photos.
No odometer or mileage display visible. Cannot verify from photos.
No visible heating elements or indicators on the handlebars. Cannot confirm from photos.

claims.claim: Bought new 6 months ago. Gears and brakes perfect, no rust, all parts original.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The motorcycle may not be a Triumph Sprint or may be a different model altogether.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the front or side panel showing the brand and model name, or a VIN plate.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic sport motorcycle, not a Triumph Sprint, which would reduce value.

risks.risk: The motorcycle may have hidden mechanical issues or low mileage.
risks.proof: A photo of the odometer reading and a video of the engine running.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or with unknown mileage, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The heated handgrip claim may be false or non-functional.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the handlebars showing heating elements or a video of the handgrip being heated.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as without heated handgrip, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the VIN plate, usually on the dashboard by the windscreen or inside the driver's door.
Clear photo of the front or side panel showing the brand and model name.
Video of the engine running and the handgrip being heated.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
